newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton plans to drill 100 wells in '97.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton plans to drill 100 wells in '97.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp said on Thursday that it plans to drill 100 wells during 1997 with a capital budget of about $60 million.
The company has funded about $25 million of strategic acreage and production acquisitions, with borrowings under its $250 million bank credit agreement during the first nine months of 1996.

The company noted that it drilled 35 wells during the first nine months of 1996 and completed 27 of them, for a success rate of 77 percent. The drilling program has been accelerated and expanded since the end of the second quarter.

An additional 35 wells are planned during the fourth quarter of 1996 in several different drilling areas, including southwestern Kansas, the Williston Basin, the Austin Chalk trend of Texas, the Texas Panhandle, the Permian Basin and northern Oklahoma.
Hugoton, an oil and natural gas company, said it increased its 1996 capital budget to $40 million to cover the drilling program and three-dimensional seismic activities.
